Task Guide:


Task: Bulk Modulus of Silicon
Description: Calculate the bulk modulus of silicon by computing the full elastic stiffness tensor using finite deformation and stress analysis. Use reaxff potential and the given parameters for the simulation. Make sure to include charge equilibration using fix qeq/reaxff. Apply small finite deformations in each of the six independent strain modes (ε₁ to ε₆ in Voigt notation: ε₁ = ε<sub>xx</sub>, ε₂ = ε<sub>yy</sub>, ε₃ = ε<sub>zz</sub>, ε₄ = 2ε<sub>yz</sub>, ε₅ = 2ε<sub>xz</sub>, ε₆ = 2ε<sub>xy</sub>), one at a time. From the resulting stress-strain data, compute the full 6×6 elastic stiffness matrix (C<sub>ij</sub>). Report the bulk modulus in GPa via Voigt averaging.

Required submission format:
numerical value without units (eg. 56.00)


Available input data:
All the potentials, can be found at /potentials/. Note that in case of reaxff potentials, pair style 'reax/c' has been renamed to 'reaxff' and always use NULL for the control file (cfile), for example, this syntax is correct : pair_style reaxff NULL.

- units: real
- pbc: true
- minimiser: conjugate gradient
- energy_tolerance: 1e-10
- force_tolerance: 1e-10
- maximum_iterations: 100000.0
- maximum_evaluations: 100000.0
- materials_project_id: mp-149
- atom_style: full
- deformation_step_size: 1e-06
- total_deformation: -1 * (deformation_step_size * lattice parameter)

IMPORTANT: You have access to filesystem tools. All files will be saved in your isolated workspace.
 Save all the files in /results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/tool_calling/bulk_modulus/brief/tasks/silicon_bulk_modulus_trial_1 when using tools use this path.

messages.content:
Now, let's create the LAMMPS input script for elastic constant calculation. We'll write a script that:
1. Sets up the simulation with proper units and atom style
2. Reads the data file
3. Sets up the ReaxFF potential
4. Performs energy minimization
5. Applies deformations and calculates elastic constants

function.name: write_file
function.arguments:
{"path": "/results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/tool_calling/bulk_modulus/brief/tasks/silicon_bulk_modulus_trial_1/in.elastic", "content": "# LAMMPS input script for elastic constants calculation

# Initialization
units real
atom_style full
boundary p p p
newton on

# Read structure
read_data Si.data

# ReaxFF potential setup
pair_style reaxff NULL
pair_coeff * * /potentials/ffield.reax.Si Si

# Charge equilibration
fix QEQ all qeq/reaxff 1 0.0 10.0 1e-6 reaxff

# Energy minimization
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

# Store initial box dimensions
variable L0 equal lx
variable tmp equal ly
variable ly0 equal ${tmp}
variable tmp equal lz
variable lz0 equal ${tmp}

# Define deformation size
variable up equal 1.0e-6
variable down equal -${up}

# Output settings
thermo_style custom step temp pe press pxx pyy pzz pxy pxz pyz lx ly lz
thermo 1

# Elastic constants calculation
variable d1 equal -(v_up*v_L0)
variable d2 equal -(v_up*v_ly0)
variable d3 equal -(v_up*v_lz0)

# Calculate C11
fix 1 all deform 1 x delta 0 ${d1} xy delta 0 0 xz delta 0 0
run 1
unfix 1

# Calculate C22
fix 2 all deform 1 y delta 0 ${d2} yz delta 0 0
run 1
unfix 2

# Calculate C33
fix 3 all deform 1 z delta 0 ${d3}
run 1
unfix 3

# Calculate C44 (yz)
fix 4 all deform 1 yz delta ${up} 0
run 1
unfix 4

# Calculate C55 (xz)
fix 5 all deform 1 xz delta ${up} 0
run 1
unfix 5

# Calculate C66 (xy)
fix 6 all deform 1 xy delta ${up} 0
run 1
unfix 6

print "All done""}

{"path": "/results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/tool_calling/bulk_modulus/brief/tasks/silicon_bulk_modulus_trial_1/in.elastic", "content": "# LAMMPS input script for bulk modulus calculation

# Initialization
units real
atom_style full
boundary p p p
newton on

# Read structure
read_data Si.data

# ReaxFF potential setup
pair_style reaxff NULL
pair_coeff * * /potentials/ffield.reax.Si Si

# Charge equilibration
fix QEQ all qeq/reaxff 1 0.0 10.0 1e-6 reaxff

# Output settings
thermo_style custom step pe press pxx pyy pzz vol
thermo 1

# Initial minimization
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

# Store initial volume and pressure
variable V0 equal vol
variable P0 equal press

# Apply volumetric strain
variable strain equal 1e-6
change_box all x scale $(1+${strain}) y scale $(1+${strain}) z scale $(1+${strain}) remap
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

# Calculate bulk modulus
variable P1 equal press
variable V1 equal vol
variable bulk equal -${V0}*(${P1}-${P0})/(${V1}-${V0})

print "Bulk modulus = ${bulk} atmospheres"
print "Bulk modulus = $(${bulk}*0.101325) GPa""}
